summary: Methanex filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) providing an operational update on its Trinidad and Tobago facilities. The company announced it could not agree to a new natural gas contract for its Titan methanol plant (860,000 tonnes/year) and will idle the facility indefinitely upon contract expiry in Q3 2026. The Atlas plant (63.1% owned) remains idled. No financial terms, prices, premiums, or shareholder voting are involved. The filing is a routine current report on business operations, not a special-situation corporate event like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring—no deal terms or strategic change triggering classification.
